name: 36559-sharegpt-30b-a3b-fp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, no expert parallel, no data parallel.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 8, warmup the first 10% by completion, bounded at 480 requests / 1800 s safety.
workload: guidellm `json_file`: configs/data/sharegpt-480-out300-qwen3-30b-a3b-fp8.jsonl, 480 real first-turn ShareGPT prompts (4-1024 tokens, 106026 in total) each carrying `output_tokens_count: 300`, sent as `request_format: plain` at temperature 0. configs/data/make-dataset.py regenerates the file deterministically.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant answering real user questions with 300-token replies, eight concurrent sessions on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
